trial_court: Family Court No.1, Bhilwara in Misc. Criminal Case No.333/2018

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Bherulal S/o Sh. Mangu Ji Jat, husband
parties.respondent_defendant: Jamna W/o Sh. Bherulal And D/o Sh. Gambhir Jat, wife

facts_of_case: Marriage of respondent was solemnized with petitioner 24 years ago. Parties separated themselves since 1999. Application under Section 125 of Cr.P.C. came to be filed on behalf of respondent-wife seeking maintenance, which came to be allowed.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can settle their disputes permanently and agree on a full and final settlement.
legal_principles.held: The parties stated before the trial Court that they have arrived at the settlement voluntarily and with full knowledge and without any coercion or duress.

legal_principles.principle: A settlement agreed upon by parties can be considered as a full and final settlement.
legal_principles.held: The parties stated before the trial Court that they have arrived at the settlement voluntarily and with full knowledge and without any coercion or duress.

outcome.final_order: Amount of maintenance was enhanced to the tune of Rs.4,000/- per month.

use_for_drafting: representing a respondent in a family court
